rows.en: Touya: "They just keep coming, one after another..."
Ai: "Touya. I'll do things my own way."
Arthur: "Forgive me, but I'll act independently
this time."
Clovis: "I'll operate alone. Take care of your end."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I'm not ready to trust you with my life yet.
I'll do as I please."
Xiujian: "...I won't follow your orders.
I'll act on my own."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice still
does not dwell within you! I cannot obey such a person!
Therefore, I shall follow my own justice! That is all!"
Celica: "Sorry to keep you waiting!"
Touya: "Celica?! What's with that mech with the pom-poms?"
Celica: "I don't know what 'pom-poms' are,
but this one's called Selphin.
It's that first Spirit Mech prototype you've heard about."
Touya: "Oh, the one you secretly put Rayblade's technology into,
making everyone an accomplice."
Celica: "What a nasty way to put it! Well, it's true.
But once you learn what this baby can really do,
you won't be saying that."
Touya: "What can it do?"
Celica: "Believe it or not,
this baby has a 'complementary repair system'
installed.
Put simply, it's a device that repairs Spirit Mech armor.
Leave any damage to me."
Touya: "I don't really get it, but if you use that device,
you can repair damage, right?
Then I'll leave repairs to you."
Celica: "Roger. But I'll need your orders."
Ai: "That's... Orbest! Is that Kasumi?!"
Touya: "What?!"
Kasumi: "I'm sorry! But I don't want to be a burden either.
You and everyone else are in danger, Touya-chan,
and I can't just do nothing..."
Ai: "You mean 'Touya,' not 'everyone else,' right?"
Kasumi: "..."
Ymir: "Anyway, she's already launched,
so we can't change that. Luckily, she seems to be near the nest...
Kasumi, do you know how to use the Spread Missile?"
Kasumi: "Y-Yes! Should I fire over there?"
Ymir: "Yes, please."
Kasumi: "Understood!
Um, disengage the safety and check the target...!!"
Kasumi: "What's that...?"
Kasumi: "No..."
Kasumi: "N..."
Kasumi: "N-Nooooo!!!!"
Kasumi: "Aaaaaah... Wait, huh?"
Clovis: "That's scary..."
Xiujian: "A fine example of how the quiet ones
can react when their restraint snaps."
Fain: "I didn't see it. I saw nothing!"
Arthur: "It seems we'd better not make her angry."
Touya: "Yeah. I know that from experience."
Touya: "Something huge just came out..."
Clovis: "Careful. It's in a different league from the others."
Fain: "Is that the Queen?
Then the main attraction has arrived."
Yamato: "Hey, don't the Baluamy look more lively too?"
Touya: "...Yeah. We might have to be careful.
Anyway, we've got to do something about these things.
...Let's go!"
Yamato: "Touya!"
Touya: "Yeah. We won't get anywhere unless we hit the source..."
Ymir: "Everyone! We've found a suspicious location up ahead."
Touya: "It sure looks the part.
Maybe that Queen thing is over there.
All right, let's do something about it!"
Touya: "There are still more?!"
Yamato: "This is getting dangerous..."
Touya: "What do I do...?"
Yamato: "Touya! Isn't this getting bad?!"
Touya: "Stay calm... Stay calm... What can I do...?"
Yamato: "Touya...?"
Touya: "..."
Touya: "L-Like this? I-It's a bit heavy..."
Reduce: "Keep it there. Breathe in slowly and deeply,
then picture that air gathering at your blade's tip."
Touya: "How am I... Right. Picture it."
Reduce: "Yes. Shut your eyes and focus.
Don't try to reason it out."
Touya: "O-Okay..."
Touya: "...That's it. That time..."
Touya: "Heart..."
Touya: "Image..."
Touya: "Here I goooo!"
Yamato: "A-Amazing... That was amazing, Touya!"
Touya: "Heh heh... All right! Let's finish them all at once!"
